functions.name: CPUID3DNowDetection
functions.summary: CPU 3DNow! capability detection. Queries the maximum extended CPUID function with EAX = 0x80000000; if extended leaf 0x80000001 exists, issues CPUID with that leaf and returns whether bit 31 of EDX (the 3DNow! support flag) is set. Returns 0 when the extended leaf is unsupported. Called by OSVersionDetection (0x0050FDF3).

operations.description: Set EAX = 0x80000000 and execute CPUID to query the maximum extended function number.
Execute the CPUID instruction (inline asm) with EAX = 0x80000000.
Guard on returned EAX >= 0x80000001: extended leaf 0x80000001 (feature flags) is available.
Set EAX = -2147483647 to select the extended feature-flags leaf 0x80000001.
Execute the CPUID instruction (inline asm) with EAX = -2147483647.
Return (_EDX < 0): the sign bit (bit 31) of EDX is the 3DNow! support flag; the BOOL result is per the ABI lead.
Fallback: return 0 (v11) when extended leaf 0x80000001 is unsupported.
Called by OSVersionDetection (0x0050FDF3) during OS/CPU capability detection.

unresolved: Only the 3DNow! bit (EDX bit 31) is tested; other extended feature flags are not consumed here.
The ABI lead FAIL_50fd16 has no named prototype; the BOOL return type comes from the raw source.

policy: Architecture is a DERIVED proposal. Validated function IR and its evidence references outrank worker synthesis.
